ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Safety In and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Our ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Our Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

5. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

6. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

8. C — Ice melting to water

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

10. B — newton (N)

11. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
